data.name: Towers Heritage
data.detailed_description:
Roadmap

To end early access

  • Story mode : Act 2 and 3

  • Multiplayer mode : more levels in the catalog

  • Multiplayer mode : different difficulty level for the bots

  • Tower workshop : improve Bunker and Tall base

  • Better balance fights

  • Fix bugs


About the Game

A tower defense revisiting the genre for both enjoyers of the old sweet TD days and newcomers.

Defend your kingdom, customize your towers and play online or offline in this tribute to the Tower Defense genre.

How would you like to play an old-school Tower Defense where you can play with your friends and create your own towers to craft new strategies?

Towers Heritage is a tribute to the classics of the genre while adding a dose of innovation with an online multiplayer mode and a unique tower creation workshop.

Dive in a fantasy world where, as a protector of the kingdom, you must defend your lands against relentless waves of enemies. Strategically place your towers along the paths or build an overwhelming maze of destruction.

Not in the mood to play with other players? No problem!

🏰 Enjoy the single-player adventure with a captivating campaign mode.

🏰 Take on bots in a skirmish mode.

Looking for a completely different challenge? Become the invader! Unleash waves of enemies on your opponents and expand your kingdom.

Developed by a passionate indie from the heart of the French countryside, Towers Heritage is a personnal tribute this genre, that tag along since his childhood.

Whether you want to enjoy a chill game or a real strategic challenge, there's something for everyone.

⚔️ Add to your wishlist now and take a seat among legends of TD ⚔️

Content

Mode campaign

Take command of a mercenary company hired by Duke Enguerrand to bring peace to the Kingdom of Wylma. Try to save the continent from a growing invasion: help your allies defend their lands, explore neighboring realms, protect your strongholds, and launch assaults against the forces of evil!

Skirmish Mode (Online & Offline)

Choose the number of players — from 1 to 7 players.

Select your game mode:

  • Cooperative: everyone defends the same path, with each player responsible for a specific section. Lives are shared among all players — either everyone wins, or everyone loses! Depending on the map, if enemy units break through one player’s defenses, they can be intercepted by the next player down the line, and so on. True teamwork at its finest!

  • Free-for-All: each player defends their own lane. If a player loses all their lives, they’re eliminated. Those who survive until the end claim victory!

Choose the map (some maps are exclusive to specific modes).

Select the enemy army you’ll face:

  • From pre-made armies, ready to give everything to reach your base.

  • Or by using the Tavern, a building where you can recruit monsters to send against your opponents.

Adjust the difficulty settings to match your preferred challenge level: number of lives to protect, gold recovery rate from defeated monsters, and more.

If you’re playing offline, you can play with bots. Otherwise, create or join online matches and share the fun with players around the world!

Tower Creation Workshop

Master the game’s combat system and use it to craft your own towers to dominate the battlefield.

Choose your tower base:

  • Classic

  • Tall, specialized against flying units

  • Bunker, designed for ground and close-combat defense

Select a weapon from a wide range of exciting options (crossbow, cannon, tesla coil, and more).

Equip one or more combat abilities (explosive damage, slowing effect, aura buffs, etc.).

Define your base stats (damage, range, reload speed), maximum level, and upgrade curve to achieve the perfect synergy for your strategy!

Is your tower too powerful to be accepted in-game? Add some penalties to balance it out — cost, build time, and more.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600, 3.3 GHz / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X, 3.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti / Radeon R7 360
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
